tools.name: analyze_invoice_text
tools.description: Extract common invoice fields from user-supplied text, check dates and subtotal-plus-tax arithmetic, flag likely duplicates, and return a review queue. Human source review is required.

tools.name: validate_invoice_records
tools.description: Recheck structured invoice records for missing fields, invalid dates, arithmetic mismatches, and likely duplicates without reading files.

tools.name: export_invoice_records
tools.description: Prepare reviewed invoice records as spreadsheet-safe CSV text. Invalid and duplicate rows remain visible in the review export.
